job.job_description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to lead the design and development of scalable, cloud-native backend systems and AI-powered platforms. You will be responsible for architecting highly available microservices, designing APIs, building data processing pipelines, and developing backend systems that support large-scale NLP and AI workloads.
This role requires strong expertise in backend development using Python and Node.js , deep experience with AWS cloud services, and hands-on knowledge of processing large datasets to build enterprise AI solutions. You will work closely with architects, data scientists, frontend engineers, DevOps, and product teams to deliver secure, high-performance applications.
Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture Development
Design and develop scalable backend applications using Python and Node.js
Build secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and asynchronous event-driven services.
Design modular, reusable, and maintainable software following industry best practices.
Lead backend architecture discussions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
AI, NLP Data Processing
Design and implement large-scale document and data processing pipelines.
Build backend systems supporting AI and NLP workloads.
Develop services for processing structured and unstructured datasets.
Integrate Large Language Models LLMs and other AI services into enterprise applications.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to deploy production-ready machine learning models.
Optimize AI inference pipelines for performance and cost.
Cloud Engineering (AWS)
Design, deploy, and manage cloud-native applications using AWS services including:
Amazon EKS
AWS Lambda
Amazon EC2
Amazon S3
Amazon RDS
Amazon ECS
IAM
CloudWatch
EventBridge
SQS/SNS
API Gateway
Secrets Manager
CloudFront
Designing highly available cloud architectures.
Infrastructure automation.
Performance optimization.
Cost optimization.
Security best practices.
Disaster recovery planning.
Database Data Engineering
Design scalable database schemas.
Optimize SQL queries and indexing strategies.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
Build ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
Handle large-scale data migration and processing.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and high availability.
DevOps Platform Engineering
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Containerize applications using Docker.
Deploy applications to Kubernetes (Amazon EKS).
Implement logging, monitoring, and observability solutions.
Improve deployment automation and operational efficiency.
Leadership Mentorship
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
Conduct architecture and code reviews.
Define engineering standards and best practices.
Participate in sprint planning and technical estimation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Required Technical Skills Programming Languages
Python (Expert)
Node.js (Expert)
JavaScript / TypeScript
Backend Technologies
REST APIs
GraphQL
Microservices Architecture
Event-Driven Architecture
Message Queues
Asynchronous Processing
API Security
Authentication Authorization (OAuth2, JWT)
Frontend (Working Knowledge)
React.js
Next.js
AWS Cloud
VPC
Route 53
Elastic Load Balancer
Auto Scaling
SQS
SNS
AWS Secrets Manager
Databases
PostgreSQL
MySQL
MongoDB
Redis
Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
Required Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5-8 years of experience in backend software development.
Proven experience designing scalable distributed systems.
Strong experience building cloud-native applications on AWS.
Experience working with large datasets and high-throughput systems.
Hands-on experience deploying production applications to Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of software design patterns and system architecture.
Preferred Qualifications
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python and Node.js.
Experience building AI-driven enterprise platforms.
Experience developing NLP applications.
Experience integrating commercial or open-source LLMs into production systems.
Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST, or other regulated environments.
Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Experience with performance tuning and cost optimization on AWS.
